dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm a gang member. Don't care about that, do you?

dialogues.speaker: Havu
dialogues.text: Huh? L—Like heck you are! It's not that easy to join the Conch Gang... Wait, why are you even telling me this!?

dialogues.speaker: Havu
dialogues.text: The Conch Gang's none of my business. None at all...
